{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVMdNDs8AAAABbUYCGw", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BnXy5zhE5R7g", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BnXy5", "number": 71, "title": "Enable Gene Light's full six-chain IK through ordered append/grant evaluation (physics off)", "body": "## Motivation / user-visible failure

The public MMD-vs-glTF comparison now has an **IK** On/Off control (completed [Issue #69](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/issues/69) / [PR #70](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/pull/70)). It works on **Uka** (all 10 source IK controllers), but on **Gene Light** the checkbox is **disabled and reports `IK unavailable`**. The user wants the remaining dependency resolved, so Gene can use the same honest, model-wide IK On/Off interaction in both views.

**Required outcome:** Support the *actual source-ordered append/grant dependency* that blocks Gene Light IK, then execute **all six valid Gene source IK chains** in the direct PMX, glTF Toon and glTF PBR instances. IK Off must bypass all IK, restoring exactly the raw motion pose. **Physics/Bullet stays OFF**. This is a public comparison feature, not merely a synthetic test or a hidden partial-chain workaround.

**Handoff / ownership:** An implementation issue for the designated implementer. The Issue author does **not** write code, make a branch, or open a PR.

## Verified source evidence and blocker

At main commit `a87db5840058e9db312ed99676f963be361e370a`:

- [Current comparison IK adapter](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/comparison-ik.ts): `comparisonIK()` discovers the model's IK controllers and ancestry, then marks any chain whose dependency contains a grant/append as unsupported (`append dependency <index> requires a separate runtime`). Its **all-or-nothing** capability policy disables the entire model, rather than silently running five of six chains.
- [Current public playback](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/main.ts): builds independent IK adapters from direct PMX MMDLoader metadata and glTF `extras.sourceSolvers`, requires matching capabilities across the PMX/Toon/PBR skeletons, and evaluates raw VMD first, then IK. It currently has **no ordered grant/append stage**.
- [Recorded Gene real-model evidence](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/comparison-ik-evidence.json), plus [the human-readable policy](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/public-motion.md#issue-69-observed-evidence): Gene has **six** IK controllers, with five individually supported and one blocked:
  - **38 `右腕xcIK`**, effector 37, link 36, 15 iterations; ancestry includes **bone 35 `右肩連`**, which has an **append/grant rotation dependency on bone 26 (ratio 1)**. This is the reported blocker.
  - **178 `前クローク2_1xcIK`**, effector 177, link 176, with full XYZ limits.
  - **86 `左足ＩＫ`**, **87 `左つま先ＩＫ`**, **97 `右足ＩＫ`**, **98 `右つま先ＩＫ`**.
  - Execution is phase/layer/source-index ordered. Inspect actual PMX flags, grant-space semantics, rest rotations and dependencies before implementing; do not blindly assume all append operations are equivalent.
- Existing reference behavior: [`@takahirox/three-mmd` GrantSolver](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/GrantSolver.ts) handles local/global translation/rotation grants with rest matrices and weighted quaternions; its [MMDAnimationHelper `_animatePMXMesh`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/animation/MMDAnimationHelper.ts#L1007-L1044) **interleaves grant updates and IK by PMX phase, transformation class and source index**. Running *all grants first and all IK later* can change results and should not be substituted for ordered processing.
- [Pure solver append/IK evaluator](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/packages/mmd-solver/index.ts) already contains append composition logic for supported solver profiles, while [`tools/pmx-solver.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tools/pmx-solver.ts) maps source `grant` flags to `append`. However the current **public** models were built as `mode:'bdef', solver:'none', physics:'none'`, so the deployed viewer uses source metadata and an independent IK adapter. Evaluate reuse of existing logic without silently opting into unsupported solver-v3 features.
- The Gene source is pinned at [`mmdagent-ex/gene` commit `c7eace43dffaccff6ad0597433ef85fa57c91e03`](https://github.com/mmdagent-ex/gene/tree/c7eace43dffaccff6ad0597433ef85fa57c91e03), using **Gene_light.pmx**, with byte integrity specified in [the manifest](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/tools/gene-light-manifest.json).

Do **not** mark the work done by dropping controller 38, ignoring bone 35, forcing the checkbox enabled or copying completed bone rotations between the two panes. The observed blocker must actually be evaluated.

## Implementation requirements

### 1. Audit the source grant and ordered dependency graph

- [ ] Parse the **real pinned Gene_light.pmx** and document the complete grant records relevant to its six IK controllers: source and destination index/name, flags (local/global; rotation/translation), rate, PMX deformation layer, pre/post physics flag, rest translation/quaternion, bone parent ancestry, and whether the source value itself is influenced by another grant or IK.
- [ ] Confirm the recorded `右肩連` (35) ← source (26), ratio 1 relationship against the original source and identify the exact point at which it must be evaluated relative to controller `右腕xcIK` (38). Audit the other five chains for indirect dependency changes when interleaving append + IK.
- [ ] Establish an explicit comparison oracle: authored pose → ordered applicable grants/IK with physics disabled, including VMD per-controller switches. Use the pinned direct PMX library's ordered `GrantSolver`/`CCDIKSolver` path or independent reference measurements to cross-check calculations, not just the same newly written adapter on both panes.

### 2. Implement correct symmetric append + IK execution

- [ ] Extend or replace [`examples/comparison-ik.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/examples/comparison-ik.ts) with an **ordered source-driven deformation pass** that processes required append/grant operations and all six Gene IK chains in the correct **phase → layer → source-index** order. Validate dependencies/cycles before execution. Respect full XYZ link bounds, source iterations/step angle, and local/global plus rotation/translation grant semantics. Retain the original source names and indices in diagnostics.
- [ ] Use the same behavior in three independent instances: left MMD direct PMX, right glTF Toon and glTF PBR. Build metadata from `MMDLoader` on the left, `extras.sourceSolvers`/retained source on the right; verify equivalent source identities, grant parameter normalization, coordinate reflection, rest/bind transforms and update matrices before each downstream IK reads its inputs.
- [ ] Keep `IK` as the **single visible On/Off checkbox**. **On** means the complete executable set for the selected model, and specifically all **six Gene chains**; **Off** applies **no IK** and must not leave a residual procedural grant/IK pose. Since grant is an internal prerequisite of Gene IK, document whether it operates only while IK is enabled or is independently required by the chosen raw comparison policy; keep semantics consistent for both panes and explicit in diagnostics. Do not add a confusing public `Grant` or `Sleeve IK` control.
- [ ] Preserve Uka's existing **ten-chain** IK behavior and measured sleeve tracking. Avoid broadening Uka's deformation unexpectedly: inspect its two eye grants (outside IK dependency closure) and do not silently enable unrelated morph/physics features. If an append step is required for a Gene chain, run it as needed, rather than indiscriminately executing every PMX feature in every model.
- [ ] Keep **physics disabled** (`solver:'none', physics:'none'` transport policy unless a well-justified compatible extension change is necessary; **no Bullet/Ammo creation or requests**). Fixed/local-axis writable-link limitations, external parents and unsupported graph cases must still be correctly diagnosed. Do not silently accept a partially executed model as generic “IK on”.
- [ ] Make the pipeline **deterministic and non-accumulating**. Restore the original authored/raw pose before evaluating each absolute VMD time; account for untracked joints and Three.js mixer caches. Repeated same-time or backward seeks, IK Off→On→Off while paused, loop boundary, Rest, motion A→B→A, model Uka↔Gene, and Toon↔PBR switches must not retain stale grant/IK rotations. Atomic failure or explicit unavailable state is preferable to partially mutating one skin.
- [ ] Preserve the **one model with three named animations** per character and seamless in-memory motion selection from Issue #67/#69. Toggling IK or selecting clips must not reload PMX, glTF, images, shader programs, renderer or canvas. The active VMD on all panes must remain one shared clock.

### 3. UI, diagnostics, docs and testing

- [ ] **Gene Light UI:** `#comparison-ik` becomes enabled on successful source/adapter validation, ideally defaulting On to match Uka. Preserve the minimal labels `Uka`/`Gene Light`, `IK`, existing motion/Play/Restart/time/Loop, current camera drag/orbit/zoom and no public View selector. On/Off accurately reflects actual execution and does not imply original native MMD parity.
- [ ] Expose factual per-pane diagnostics (`available`, executed source controller IDs, VMD-disabled IDs, applied grant IDs, relevant phase/layer order, and explicit remaining unsupported reasons). Distinguish global IK Off from per-VMD IK switches and runtime unavailable/failure; don't report six executed if the VMD disables any. Keep verbose metadata in collapsed details, not permanently visible prose.
- [ ] Add **real Gene Light** Node + browser conformance cases with the pinned sample, Laugh and Apology motions. Verify bone 35 receives correct appended rotation at representative frames and controller 38 acts on the **properly updated ancestry**; also verify all remaining five IK chains are available/processed. Measure joint/effector positions and independent rendered pixels for left PMX, Toon glTF and PBR glTF with IK On vs Off. Include at least one sample where the append dependency materially changes the output, so a stub/no-op cannot pass.
- [ ] Preserve `#comparison-ik` disabled/unavailable handling for genuinely malformed/unsupported fixtures. Add negative cases: cyclic/missing grant source, unsupported local/grant flags or invalid numeric rates, incompatible PMX/glTF metadata, invalid chain/order/phase dependencies, VMD controls that disable one or more chains, and safe recovery after a failed evaluation. Do not reject otherwise valid MMD **source transport** solely because execution is unsupported.
- [ ] Update [`docs/public-motion.md`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/public-motion.md), [`docs/comparison-ik-evidence.json`](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/comparison-ik-evidence.json), relevant README/credits and tests to remove stale “Gene IK unavailable” language **only if actually solved**. Keep Uka's [sleeve evidence](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/uka-sleeves.md) and preserve original CC BY 4.0/usage notices for both models.
- [ ] Run `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, applicable real-asset `npm run test:browser` suites (IK, body-motion, public-motion, camera/Uka/unified), `npm run check:links`, and `git diff --check`; report measured results, failures/skips and any difference between observed project behavior and external MMD references.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Gene's `IK` checkbox is operable (not permanently disabled); **all six source IK controllers are supported**, with required grant/append dependency evaluated at the correct source order on all three independent loaded skins.
- [ ] IK On vs Off produces observable **correct grant-dependent right-arm IK** changes in Gene; trace source bone 35 and controller 38, confirm other five chains and compare the resulting PMX/glTF poses within justified tolerances. IK Off reliably restores the raw pose.
- [ ] Uka's ten chains and sleeve follow still work; no accidental grant/IK accumulation, extra physics, missing morphs, camera resets, or motion/model reloads.
- [ ] All three VMD choices, repeated/backward seek, Loop, Rest, switching modes and materials maintain shared time and correct procedural ownership.
- [ ] The UI continues to show only **IK** (not “Sleeve IK”), no View presets, with truthful concise status and full collapsed diagnostics. Non-executable source cases fail explicitly rather than silently running fewer IK chains.
- [ ] Real-source and negative tests plus all relevant project checks pass; no unsupported native MikuMikuDance-fidelity claim.

## Related work

- [Issue #69](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/issues/69), merged [PR #70](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/pull/70): model-wide IK with truthful all-or-nothing gating; Gene blocked by append 35.
- [Issue #67](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/issues/67), merged [PR #68](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/pull/68): single shared multi-animation asset per model and measured Uka sleeve follow.
- [Gene Light source/rights](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/gene-light.md).
- [Source transport and runtime limitations](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/main/docs/source-transport.md).

## Optional validation

Inspect Gene's right-shoulder/arm behavior in both panes with original-model visual captures; compare against original Windows MMD or separately measured MikuDanceStudio if available. Do not report parity without such measurements.

## Required post-merge verification

None required, except genuine deployment-only behavior that cannot be tested before merge.
